# Scatterplot
participants_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = el_scs, y = wordid_sts)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = lm, col = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 18, 2)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(60, 150, 10)) + 
  labs(x = "Elision", y = "Word Identification") +
  theme_bw()

fig_wordid_sts <- participants_df |>
  ggplot(aes(1, wordid_sts)) + 
  geom_rain(
    violin.args = list(alpha = 0.8, color = "#1e90ff", fill = "#1e90ff"), 
    point.args = list(alpha = 0.8, color ="#1e90ff"),
    boxplot.args = list(alpha = 0.8, color = "#1e90ff", outlier.shape = NA)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 55 , color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 70 , color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 130, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 145, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.9, 1.5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(50, 150), breaks = seq(55, 145, 15)) + 
  labs(title = "Reading Skill") + 
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 63, label = "-2 SD") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 138, label = "+2 SD") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
    axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) + 
  coord_flip()
print(fig_wordid_sts)
ggsave("fig_wordid_sts.png", fig_wordid_sts, width = 6, height = 4)

Three-way intearctions

  • Model 1: word ID ~ sex + dataset + age * elision * matrix reasoning
  • Model 2: elision ~ sex + dataset + age * word ID * matrix reasoning
# Model summary
lm1 <- lm(
  wordid_sts ~ sex + dataset + age * el_scs * mr_sts, 
  data = participants_df
)

summary(lm1)

# Interaction effect plot
lm1_effect <- interact_plot(
  model = lm1, 
  pred = el_scs, 
  modx = mr_sts, 
  modx.values = c(70, 85, 100, 115, 130),
  mod2 = age, 
  mod2.values = c(9.5, 13.5),
  mod2.labels = c(
    "9.5 years old (range 7.5 - 11.5)", 
    "13.5 years old (range 11.5 - 16.7)"
  ),
  main.title = "word ID ~ sex + dataset + age * elision * matrix reasoning (n = 409)",
  legend.main = "Nonverbal IQ",
  plot.points = T,
  colors = c("#d7191c", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#a6d96a", "#1a9641"),
  point.alpha = 0.8,
  jitter = 0.1
)

fig_lm1_effect <- lm1_effect +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Nonverbal IQ",
    values = c("solid", "solid", "solid", "solid", "solid")
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2, 19), breaks = seq(2, 18, 2)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(55, 145), breaks = seq(55, 145, 10)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Elision", 
    y = "Word Reading",
  ) + 
  theme_bw()
Scale for linetype is already present.
Adding another scale for linetype, which will replace the existing scale.
print(fig_lm1_effect)
ggsave(
  "fig_wordid_sts_three-way-interaction.png", 
  fig_lm1_effect,
  height = 5,
  width = 8,
)
